Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The search covered the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre, the country's only higher theatre school, whose performing arts department was read at source: the specialisms listed are acting, directing, dramaturgy, theatre arts and pedagogy, and contemporary performing arts. No mention of puppet theatre. The previous value of 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range produced without research; it moves to 0. Confidence stays at estimate rather than sourced: the source read establishes the absence of a puppetry stream at the national theatre school, which is not the same as its absence in the country. An absence cannot be sourced the way a presence can. Upper bound held at 1 for that reason.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
